symptom: `create page … { use building block B.Alert_Info as a_ }; alter page … { set (Class: 'x') on a_container99 }` passes `check -p` and exec stops on `failed to resolve page target: widget "a_container99" not found`; on a STORED page, `insert … { use building block B.Card as s_ }` then `insert after s_container2` was refused by check although exec ran it, and `set … on s_text99` was waived
cause: No pass resolved an ALTER target on a document the same script creates — the stored-document passes skip it, so even a plain misspelt widget passed. For stored pages the script's additions (widgetsTheScriptAddsTo) were read before expansion: the `use building block` sentinel counted as one widget named after the block, and every unresolved SET target on a grown page was waived
file: `mdl/executor/validate_script_widget_targets.go` (`validateScriptWidgetTargets`, `knownWidgetNames`, MDL-ALTER02, run from ValidateProgram); `validate_alter_page_refs.go` (`widgetsTheScriptAddsTo`); `validate_alter_set.go` (the grows waiver); `validate_page_context.go` (`expandUseRefsForCheckReporting`)
insight: #559 fixed the CREATE side by expanding before counting names; every other place check reads widget names off a parsed tree needs the same pre-pass, and the gap shows up wherever check replaces 'open the stored document' with 'trust the script'. Replay the script's documents in statement order with exec's own expansion (expandIfFragment) rather than a second expander, and fail open, never closed: an unexpandable reference (no project, unknown block, script-defined fragment) allows every name under its prefix (all names if unprefixed), and a tree with derived addresses (DataGrid 2 columns, object-list items) allows every name. Measured on 11.12.1 with Atlas_Web_Content.Card: the reported script refused by check with `did you mean a_container2`; two prefixed copies plus an alter-inserted third, targeted in the same and a later statement, check clean, exec, mx check 0 errors; the stored-page insert-after-block script now checks clean, execs, 0 errors. Tests `validate_script_widget_targets_2182_test.go`; control = pass stubbed to nil (5 tests fail with no report) and expansion stubbed to nil ctx (the two block-name tests fail)
